title: Targets set by SMS are always "Eating Soon" in NS
body:
Sending SMS like "TARGET HYPO" the reason is always "Eating Soon" in Nightscout.

Via SMS "TARGET HYPO":

```
eventType Temporary Target
duration 60
durationInMilliseconds 3600000
isValid true
created_at 2022-06-10T03:14:41.166Z
enteredBy AndroidAPS
reason Eating Soon
targetBottom 160
targetTop 160
units mg/dl
```

via GUI "Button Hypo":

```
eventType Temporary Target
duration 60
durationInMilliseconds 3600000
isValid true
created_at 2022-06-09T18:50:44.000Z
enteredBy AndroidAPS
reason Hypo
targetBottom 160
targetTop 160
units mg/dl
```
